description: Source code for driver commands related to nl80211 in wpa_supplicant, including functions for driver control, P2P NoA, and WPS P2P IE handling.

methods.name: wpa_driver_nl80211_driver_cmd
methods.description: Handles driver commands such as START, STOP, MACADDR, and RELOAD for nl80211 driver.

methods.name: wpa_driver_set_p2p_noa
methods.description: Sets P2P Notice of Absence (NoA) parameters.

methods.name: wpa_driver_get_p2p_noa
methods.description: Retrieves P2P Notice of Absence (NoA) parameters.

methods.name: wpa_driver_set_ap_wps_p2p_ie
methods.description: Sets WPS P2P Information Elements for the AP.
